items.0: Drink enough water through the day, especially when it is hot.
items.1: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds before eating and after using the toilet.
items.2: Only take antibiotics prescribed by a doctor, and finish the course as prescribed.
items.3: Keep a list of your current medicines and bring it to every doctor visit.
items.4: Walking for half an hour on most days is good for your heart and mood.
items.5: Enough sleep at night helps your body recover and supports your immunity.
items.6: Check your blood pressure regularly; high blood pressure often has no symptoms.
